meta.tagline: Replace this with a one-line description of what this project actually is.

overview: This is the demo tenant — it shows the shape of a Project OS board with prompts in place of real content. Answer each question yourself, or point an AI assistant (Claude Code, or any AI with file access) at this project's data/marketing.json and ask it to fill each section in based on what you tell it about the project. When you're ready for your own board, run `node scaffold.mjs <slug> "Project Name"` from the repo root.

journal.title: Kickoff — replace with what actually happened
journal.summary: The journal is your work log. Each entry is a day's worth of what happened, what got done, and what's next. Log entries by hand with `node osctl.mjs journal "Title" "What happened"`, or let the AI updater summarize your Claude Code sessions automatically (see README.md).
done: A concrete thing that actually got finished today
next: What you're planning to do next
